defective_pattern: Leaking typesetting or formatting instructions into APA 7 table notes.
why_defective: Table notes should only contain explanatory information about the table contents. Exposing metadata or typesetting instructions violates APA 7 standards and degrades deliverable quality.
observed_symptoms: Table notes contain raw formatting commands, XML tags, or phrases like 'typesetting instruction' or 'metadata'.
corrective_remedy: Strip all typesetting instructions and metadata from the final output. Ensure table notes strictly contain standard APA 7 explanatory text.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Typesetting or formatting commands present in table notes.
